evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/s/a is the hover-description config interface. Its sections cover Color scheme, Item hovers and Entity hovers, with background/border colors and item/entity hover visibility controls.
The config contains SpawnPK-specific controls including wandering-merchant task icons, sink values, guides, bank/equipment/inventory descriptions and wilderness suppression rules.
Sibling rs/s/s/b resolves this config and publishes its values into the live hover-description presentation state under config group hoverdesc.

candidates.note: Conservative exact-v308 name from the preserved Hover Descriptions plugin identity; no upstream RuneLite source identity is claimed.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/s/b carries plugin name 'Hover Descriptions' and config group 'hoverdesc'.
The plugin injects HoverDescriptionsConfig, copies item/entity/color settings into live static hover state, reacts to ConfigChanged and resets the presentation state during lifecycle transitions.
The plugin controls item descriptions and player/NPC/object/guide hover presentation only; it does not own generic TooltipOverlay rendering itself.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 plugin identity from the preserved descriptor and behavior.
